date.as_written: naipālikābde ṛṣilokavāhair, yukte nabhau pūrṇṇahimāṃśu(muttau) | śukle dine

notes: The chronogram 'ṛṣi-loka-vāhaiḥ' gives 737 NS (ṛṣi = 7, loka = 3, vāha = 7). 'nabhau' refers to the month of Śrāvaṇa, and 'pūrṇṇa-himāṃśu... śukle dine' indicates the full moon day (Śukla Pūrṇimā). The scribe's name is given as 'munināmadheyaḥ' ('named Muni').
